alisa: quick heads-up — planning prod canary rollout tonight at 18:30 UTC. Release owner: @sam. SRE: @maria. QA: @derek. Can people ack the pre-deploy checklist below so we can start the window on time?

alisa: PRE-DEPLOY CHECK (please reply with ✅ or issues):
- [ ] infra smoke in staging ✅
- [ ] DB migrations dry-run ✅
- [ ] feature flags created and reversible ✅
- [ ] rollback playbook reviewed ✅
- [ ] perf/latency dashboards pinned & alert thresholds set ✅
- [ ] canary traffic step plan (10/30/100) agreed ✅
- [ ] runbook + oncall contact updated (pager/zoom) ✅

sam: ack — I'll run the deploy script and watch release logs. I'll pause at each traffic step and call it. :thumbsup:

maria: oncall here — alerts verified, synthetic p99 check enabled, circuit-breaker thresholds loaded. I'll take first 30m of observation. :white_check_mark:

derek: QA completed staging smoke earlier, attaching quick smoke output: `ok: 128/128 endpoints 200, median latency 38ms`. No regression found. ✅

sam: one note — migration has an optional index background job. I added `--defer-index` flag to rollout plan to avoid lock. Confirmed with DB team.

alisa: good call, thanks. Anyone see a blocker?

derek: none from QA. If we see elevated 5xxs during 10% step, we'll abort and roll back to previous image.

maria: agreed. If p50 or p95 jump >2x baseline for >5m, I'll flip the rollback toggle and notify.

alisa: perfect. Marking this thread as all checks green. Starting at 18:30 UTC. @deploy-bot will post start/finish hooks. Everyone please be available for the 30min window. :rocket:

deploy-bot: scheduled deploy window created for 2026-06-12T18:30:00Z (canary). Hooks: pre-checks, canary-step, metrics-guard, final-sweep.

sam: ready on my side. See you in the window.

alisa: thanks team — closing sign-off. ✅
